mentions.title: What caused Mercedes' pace deficit at Sepang despite upgraded W17?
mentions.summary:
Mercedes' performance at Formula 1's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia will require further investigation as the conditions around the Sepang circuit made it difficult for the team to get a read on its latest update package.

mentions.title: Karun Chandhok raises concerns about Mercedes F1 upgrade performance
mentions.summary:
Sky Sports pundit and former Formula 1 driver Karun Chandhok believes Mercedes should be "concerned" by its latest upgrade package, warning that the new aerodynamic parts have failed to deliver the desired jump in performance.
